steps.action: Stack the two red round 2x2 bricks in the center of the base, in front of the gray slopes.
watch_for: Center the round bricks over the green plate between the side walls
Push the second round brick firmly onto the first

steps.action: Place one blue 1x1 side-stud brick on top of each back corner of the side walls, next to the gray slopes, with the side studs facing outward.
watch_for: Side studs must face outward to the sides, not forward or inward
One brick goes at each back corner, left and right
